scope: P8-013 local invalid-measurement and comparison failure artifact behavior; not a release performance certification
method: Read full commit diff and complete comparison/gate implementations plus CLI execute and main error-handling context; no checkout or code edits to the reviewed source
accepted_behaviors: Missing or zero baseline p95 makes latency_ratio unavailable and comparison inconclusive even when the sample count meets policy
An expected measurement count of zero is invalid (exit 2); cancellation remains a separate exit 3
The CLI reserves comparison output with create_new, preventing overwrite of existing paths and dangling symlinks and eliminating exists-then-truncate race
Policy/input-lock failures emit an invalid_measurement JSON receipt and exit 2
Replaying input runs rebuilds derived summaries; raw input artifacts remain unchanged

actual_execution.reviewer_execution_note: Static independent review only. The six introduced CLI tests were read, not independently executed by this reviewer. Parent-reported baseline/repaired execution is distinct evidence and is not claimed as reviewer execution.

limitations: The existing comparison uses all recorded attempt durations for an empirical p95 ratio and query-family bootstrap for quality; it does not add lifecycle strata or a confidence interval for the latency ratio
Synthetic test fixtures with 30 timings and a single query family demonstrate gate behavior, not measured product performance or statistical release certification
This review does not establish P7 prerequisites, V20, P8-013 full release completion, or G8
No inherited validation receipt is treated as proof of the reviewed source commit
